{{Top}}
[[File:Luke_Ben_Baran_Do.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Luke and Ben Skywalker wear [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] in order to protect themselves from Dorin's helium-rich atmosphere.]]
{{Quote|Hey, there's something I've been meaning to do for you. I've been practicing while you weren't around.''"<br />"''Go ahead.''"<br />[Takes a deep breath of helium-rich air] "''♪Where fields once grew, a road runs through, and buildings hide the sun♪''"<br />"''Ben, don't.''"<br />"''♪Where grass of green could once be seen, are only gray and brown♪''"<br />"''I hate that song under ''normal'' circumstances.''"<br />"''♪My childhood home, while I did roam, became a place of sadness♪''"<br />"''I'll just wait until you pass out.''"<br />"''♪Now I return, my heart does yearn for times of light and gladness♪''"<br />"''You'll make your throat sore.|[[Ben Skywalker]], teasing [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|his father]] on Dorin|<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''Helium''' was an elemental gas found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], including the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] where it coupled with [[Dorin gas/Legends|Dorin gas]].

[[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]] were known to have an allergic reaction to helium causing them to be become bloated and die.
